name: Long Beach Comic Con
blurb: A comics and pop-culture convention at the Long Beach Convention Center, with guest panels, an exhibitor hall, cosplay and artist exhibitors.
notes: The last confirmed edition ran September 5-6, 2026 (per the batch seed note), which ended before the 2026-10-05 research window. The current homepage (rendered 2026-10-05) still only advertises that same September 5 & 6, 2026 show ('LONG BEACH COMIC CON RETURNS SEPTEMBER 5 & 6, 2026!') with no next date anywhere in its text, nav or links; a WebSearch for 2027 dates likewise found none announced for Long Beach Comic Con itself (a related but separate one-day spring show, 'Long Beach Comic Expo', has a reported Feb 6, 2027 date, but that is a different event from this fall Comic Con and is out of scope for this id). Left editions empty until Long Beach Comic Con announces its next date.
